message.content:
Timing chain tensioner for a spark-ignition piston engine falls under parts of engines of heading 8409. Subheading 8409.91 covers parts suitable for use solely or principally with spark-ignition internal combustion piston engines. Within it, 8409.91.50 covers parts for engines of subheading 8407.31, 8407.32, 8407.33, 8407.34 and others, but I need to recall the statistical suffixes.

HTSUS 8409.91: 
- 8409.91.10 Parts for engines of heading 8407 used for aircraft (actually "For aircraft engines")
- 8409.91.50 Suitable for use solely or principally with engines of 8407.31 (?), etc.
- 8409.91.9990 Other (other: Other)

Recalling: 8409.91.10 is for engines of aircraft; 8409.91.20 is for parts of 8407.10 engines; 8409.91.30... 8409.91.50 is "Other: Cylinder liners/sleeves"? Rather, I recall 8409.91.50 "Fuel injection pumps"? Common entries: 8409.91.9990 "Other: Other: Other" is used for the general parts, e.g., for engine valves 8409.91.9190? Tensioners are commonly classified under 8409.91.9990.

{"hts_code": "8409.91.9990", "reason": "A timing chain tensioner is a part suitable for use solely or principally with spark-ignition internal combustion piston engines, classified in heading 8409 under subheading 8409.91 as an other part."}
